name: eliminate the vertex of smallest degree first
mechanism: repeatedly pick the vertex with the fewest current neighbours, eliminate it (its neighbours become mutually connected, which is exactly the fill that factorisation would create), and record the order; the ordering keeps the fill small

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Minimum degree algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra: permute the rows and columns of a symmetric sparse matrix before applying the Cholesky decomposition

fails_when: greedy; no optimality guarantee (the exact problem is hard)
